analyst.summary: Nuvama Wealth Management serves India's affluent and high-net-worth investors through wealth management, broking and asset-management services, and profit grew nicely in the latest quarter even as revenue was roughly flat. The company has been borrowing significantly more to fund its growth, and interest costs are consuming a larger share of earnings than is comfortable; in addition, the promoter family has pledged a large majority of their shareholding. We rate it a Hold based on the quant score, but are flagging the leverage and pledge trends for closer portfolio-manager review.
